records.text: What default decay rates does the Adam optimizer use?

records.text: How does byte pair encoding build its vocabulary?

records.text: How do stratified folds split the data in cross-validation?

records.text: Why can accuracy be misleading on imbalanced data?

records.text: How do cross-encoders and bi-encoders differ in speed and accuracy?
records.answer: A cross-encoder reads the query and a passage together in a single Transformer pass and outputs a relevance score. [3] A bi-encoder embeds queries and documents independently, so document vectors can be computed once and stored in an index. [2]
